description:
Solo R&D Toolmaker & Computational Engineer.

About Me: Ph.D. in Technological Sciences (KTH) specializing in computational modeling, multi-physics simulations, and physical metallurgy.

Project Scope: Building an interactive, SI-powered microgravity combustion dashboard for NASA’s Flame in Freefall challenge. Combining physics-informed models, transport phenomena analytics, and C/Python backends to process microgravity telemetry and evaluate fire safety thresholds for human spaceflight.
